techs.name: HZ Static
techs.notes: Ch7 (Lv 52 upgrade). 8 rapid hits. Jammed: no magic casting for 2 turns. Silences Lavos chants; reveals Vaelos's breath. +30% if tuned, against blind.

techs.name: White Noise
techs.notes: 8 ticks. Scrambles enemy plates: the second weakness is hidden for 1 turn (a gamble). Crono's crack hums and shows the galaxy for 1 s. Lv3 adds CRT-rain stagger and delays shield rebuilds +3 s.

techs.name: 56k Prayer
techs.notes: Reach 4.0. Hiss screams: +15% damage per debuff on the target. Each hit on Vaelos adds an Anti-Vaelos stack (-5% DEF for the battle).

techs.name: Red Bike Ghost
techs.notes: 1 dash. Knock-Static: the target steps at 12 fps under U2 clay rules for 2 turns (gauge 0.85x, actions hitch 0.5 s). Leaves an oil-fire line that becomes an Ash Field for Krona.

techs.name: AKIRA IN UTERO
techs.notes: Screen-wide, no damage. The jacket opens, Hiss blooms, full-screen flare: every enemy gains [HZ] as a weakness for 10 s, and for those 10 s the party hears Vaelos's true voice.

techs.name: Tune
techs.notes: Free action from 10.8, not a 11.9 row: once per turn, locks his frequency (NOISE / CARRION / SIGNAL) and ends VHS BLIND for the battle; every hit he lands carries the mode tag. SIGNAL is lost with U6_Matriarch_Unplugged.
